window: R14: UNLIMITED trades from today until Tuesday's first tip-off (24 Nov, 19:00 Athens, Besiktas–Paris). R15 is back to 4 trades.
bottom_line: Sell Nunn, Washington, Petrusev and Diarra for Justin Robinson, Tyson Carter, Jordan Nwora and Christian Koloko, and switch the coach from Laso (IST) to Navarro (RED). Zvezda at home to Virtus is the round's best stack. That takes the chance of 200 from about 12% to about 31% (almost 1 in 3).
current_fix: With no trades: captain Vezenkov (home to Hapoel), start Washington and Diarra on Tuesday, and keep Maledon as the Wednesday upgrade. Expect about 160, with a 12% chance of 200.

alerts.text: R14 has UNLIMITED trades until Tuesday 19:00 Athens. Team 2 is unchanged since R13 (Nunn, Washington, Maledon, Marinković, Vezenkov, Petrusev, Procida, Malcolm, Diarra, Kamenjas, coach Laso (IST), bank 0.0). Write any trades in teams/team2/inbox.md or save them on the page.

Prices are a round old: basketballstats.eu has no R14 price page yet, and app_prices.json is for R13. Prices changed after Friday, so re-import the official prices (README: 'Exact prices from the official game') before you trade. A leaves 0.7 in the bank as a buffer.
Barcelona are signing Killian Hayes (point guard). He was not registered for R13. If he is registered for Tuesday, Robinson's minutes are at risk: captain Vezenkov from the start in that case.

R13 was a great round for Team 2: 198 points, 2 short of the target. Nunn as captain (24 ×2) and Washington's 33 were the drivers. This report sells Washington while his 33 is fresh: he is a bench player at Bayern.
Joel Parra was ejected in overtime on Friday (two technicals). No suspension has been reported; check before buying him.
No bookmaker lines for R14 yet (checked 4 sites), so the coach pick uses the site model only: Zvezda 74%, Olympiacos 82% but at 9.9 credits, Madrid 69%.

rumours.text: Dorsey's club suspension formally ended on 12 Nov, but Bartzokas kept him out again on Friday. Milutinov (finger fracture) missed a third game, Montero is out for 6 months, and Konchar has left.
rumours.impact: Vezenkov keeps a huge usage share; Tyrique Jones (30 PIR on Friday) is the frontcourt beneficiary. Bartzokas (OLY) remains the safest coach, but at 9.9 credits.

rumours.text: Punter (ankle) is aiming to return against Madrid on 3 Dec; Evbuomwan and Gibson are out for about 3 more weeks. Killian Hayes is signing.
rumours.impact: Robinson and Brizuela keep big minutes for R14. Hayes is the threat from R15 on.

rumours.text: Campazzo (hamstring), Jantunen (plantar fascia), Deck and Garuba are out. Maledon is recovered, and Eli Ndiaye was recalled from his Joventut loan.
rumours.impact: Maledon and Feliz split the ball-handling. Martinez (MAD) is a 69% coach pick at home to Zalgiris.

rumours.text: Faried (hamstring, no return date), Santos and Sedekerskis are out, and Smits is doubtful (virus).
rumours.impact: Kamenjas stays the starting center for 30 minutes at home to Efes. Frisch gets backup minutes.

rumours.text: Awudu Abass has re-signed until the end of the season (released by Dubai).
rumours.impact: More wing depth, but not a threat to Diarra's minutes. Virtus stay a weak road team (26% at Zvezda).

rumours.text: Dzanan Musa suffered a severe eye injury on Thursday; Huertas has joined.
rumours.impact: More usage for Bacon and Petrusev against Partizan on Wednesday.

rumours.text: Stevens (calf), Vildoza (ankle), Willis and Thompson are out; Hayes is back. The president says Carlik Jones is not for sale.
rumours.impact: Marinković keeps starter-level minutes but scores little (Val 3 in the ABA). Avoid Penarroya (PAR) at Dubai.

rumours.text: Moneke was left out of the last two squads as a coach's decision, not because of injury.
rumours.impact: Nwora and Ojeleye keep the forward minutes. Moneke is not worth buying.

review: R13: your team scored 198, the best result yet and 2 short of 200. Captain Nunn 24 (×2) and Washington 33 carried it; the best captain would have been Washington (33). Laso (IST) gave +25. Last report's Variation A would have scored 173.7 (167.9 predicted), so your own lineup beat it by 24, mostly thanks to the armband and Washington. Projections: stars were over-projected by 3.6, and role-jump players under-projected again (Wright 36, Carter 30, Brizuela 31, Washington 33). That repeats for a third round, so this report leans on Carter and the role players. Research: 91 searches, 50 pages read (shared with the main team), 2 squad players unverified (Malcolm, Diarra domestic).
window_plan: The rebuild planner's best R14–R16 squad sells Nunn, Washington, Maledon, Petrusev, Malcolm and Diarra for Robinson, Hifi, Feliz, Wright, Gach and Frisch, with coach Bartzokas (OLY): about 18% a round on average. It sells Maledon, the in-form Madrid guard, and adds two minutes-starved forwards. I'd make A's five moves and keep Maledon for R15 (home to Barcelona). If you want one more free move, Procida → Brizuela (Punter out until ~3 Dec) after re-importing the prices.
